        return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);

        ntok();

        int[] a = iapar(3);
        ntok();
        int[] b = iapar(3);

        int alicemax = 0, bobmax = 0;

        if (a[0] != 0) alicemax += Math.min(a[0], b[1]);
        if (a[1] != 0) alicemax += Math.min(a[1], b[2]);
        if (a[2] != 0) alicemax += Math.min(a[2], b[0]);

        // Bob's score calculation with resource updates
        if (b[0] != 0) {
            int use1 = Math.min(b[0], a[1]);
            bobmax += use1;
            b[0] -= use1;
            if (b[0] != 0) bobmax += Math.min(b[0], a[0]);
        }
        if (b[1] != 0) {
            int use2 = Math.min(b[1], a[2]);

            b[1] -= use2;
            if (b[1] != 0) bobmax += Math.min(b[1], a[1]);

        if (b[2] != 0) {

            bobmax += use3;
            b[2] -= use3;

    public void ntok() throws IOException {
        String line = in.readLine();
        if (line == null || line.trim().isEmpty()) return;
        tok = new StringTokenizer(line);
    }

    public int ipar() {
        return tok.hasMoreTokens() ? Integer.parseInt(tok.nextToken()) : 0;
    }

    public int[] iapar(int n) {
        int[] arr = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) arr[i] = ipar();
